typeText:
∀ {k : Nat} {g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance} {m : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.InstCtx k g m →
    ∀ (i : Nat),
      LT.lt.{0} i
          (List.length.{0}
            (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.symbols (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g))) →
        Eq.{1} (m (m (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.SYMS) 1) i)))
          (List.getD.{0}
            (List.map.{0, 0} Prod.fst.{0, 0}
              (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.symbols (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g)))
            i 0)

source.code:
theorem InstCtx.sym_fst {k : ℕ} {g : GInstance} {m : Mem} (hm : InstCtx k g m) (i : ℕ)
    (hi : i < g.base.symbols.length) :
    m (m (m SYMS + 1 + i)) = (g.base.symbols.map Prod.fst).getD i 0 := by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, h4⟩ := hm.arr_syms
  rw [(h4 i hi).2.2.1, List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by rw [List.length_map]; exact hi), List.getElem_map]
